'''Nam Beroya''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior and the chieftain of [[Clan Awaud/Legends|Clan Awaud]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. A man of traditional Mandalorian warrior ways, he cared very little of politics and saw little future between [[Satine Kryze|Duchess Satine's]] [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]] and the violent [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] led by [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]]. He finally grew tired of the feud between the two groups and led his clan off world, taking them to [[Vlemoth Port/Legends|Vlemoth Port]]. There they started a new life for the warriors that chose to follow him. He continued to serve as Awaud's [[Chief/Legends|Chieftain]] until he was captured by [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian slavers]] when defending a tribe of [[Talz/Legends|Talz]] allies, and was succeeded by his daughter, [[Vera Beroya/Legends|Vera Beroya]]. He was forced to fight in the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] arena for the amusement of his Zygerrian master, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Sono Molec/Legends|Sono Molec]]. He went undefeated for two years after his capture, earning the nickname the "Prince's Sword."
